d:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the biggest entertainment releases in recent history. But can one blockbuster video game revive an industry facing layoffs, consolidation and slowing consumer spending? NYU Stern professor Joost van Dreunen and Griffin Gaming Partners’ Nick Tuosto examine what GTA 6 means for developers, distributors, industry consolidation and investment opportunities for this hundred billion-dollar industry.
More on Bloomberg Television and Markets
